Trishakti Power Generation Corporation 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Uttar Pradesh · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/59/2020/085 
 Dated: 31 Mar 2026 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "ROB - Uttar Pradesh Pkg-85" (bridges flyovers),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN
 NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 03 Mar 2020 at a gross executed value
 
 of Rs. 2510.00 Lakh (Rupees 25.10 Crore Only). 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and
 the workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Amit Mukherjee. This certificate is issued
 for record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to
 establish past performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
